title: Link replay vector fixture types are not feature-gated with their test
description: rust/lichen-link/tests/shared_vectors.rs gates test_replay_window_vectors on schnorr+std but leaves its three serde fixture structs unconditional. Clippy -D warnings for the supported schnorr without std feature set fails with dead_code. Apply the same cfg to the fixture types (or otherwise align their compilation with the test).
